statement: The repository started with exactly one tracked file (README.md, one line '# NFL1')
The official 2026 standings contain all 32 clubs with PF, PA and NET PTS, and PF - PA = NET PTS on every row
Only 6 of the transcribed Week 10 injury rows publish an injury description or a game status
Official club depth charts publish 1st through 4th string for offense and defense
Two of the three club depth charts are explicitly labelled 'Unofficial'
NFL.com publishes a Week 9 inactives list with 'emergency third QB' designations
The 2026-27 important dates article publishes the Personnel (Injury) Report Policy filing schedule
Official state data shows parlay bets lost far more often than straight bets
NIST publishes the definitions needed for correlation, cross-validation and significance testing
Pearson correlations computed from official standings are reproducible from the committed data
No official source reviewed publishes NFL betting lines, leg correlations or vig
GitHub Pages for this repo is configured to publish main / '/' (legacy build)
A second session branch is active with overlapping task claims
No strategy has passed the validation gates, therefore no leaderboard rank or score is published
